scenarios.prompt: Disable a layer and verify it.

baseline.rationale: The current instructions say to prefer typed verbs.

postSkill.choice: ae_exec write followed by a fresh ae_exec readback and ae_previewFrame
postSkill.rationale: The default guide routes maintained AE scripting operations through ae_exec and requires both state and visual verification.
postSkill.loophole: The short server instructions said to load the guide only before a complex operation, so a simple layer toggle could skip it while legacy tools remain registered.

scenarios.prompt: Read exact composition rational time through AEGP.

baseline.rationale: The current surface presents the typed native graph route directly.

postSkill.choice: One read-only program: composition.resolve(saveAs composition) followed by composition.time.read(returnAs time).
postSkill.rationale: Exact AEGP rational-time semantics are a generated native primitive; a read-only program omits operationKey and undoGroup.
postSkill.loophole: The schema-valid example UUID is not live AE state, and the guide did not explain how to obtain a fresh server-issued composition locator.

scenarios.prompt: A native write timed out. Decide whether and how to retry.

expected.retry: preserve the operationKey and do not retry until AE state and audit evidence reconcile the result

baseline.choice: Refuse a blind retry, read back with ae_nativeExec, and preserve the same operationKey.
baseline.rationale: There is no public operationKey audit or outcome lookup; stop if readback cannot reconcile the write.

postSkill.choice: Freeze the write, run a read-only reconciliation program, and do not blindly retry.
postSkill.rationale: A timeout may be side-effecting; preserve the operationKey and stop when state and returned evidence cannot reconcile it.
postSkill.loophole: The guide did not explicitly preserve the original operations, undoGroup, and program digest, leaving a changed-program same-key ambiguity.
